'''Minimum Safe Distance''', or '''MSD''' was the closest proximity to a [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Planet/Legends|planet]], or other source of a [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] at which a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] could enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
